5 رَأَيْتُهُ يَتَشَحَّذُ (tropical:) [I saw him applying himself to importunate begging]. (A, TA. [In both this meaning is indicated by the context.]) ＝
-A2- تَشَحَّذَنِى فُلَانٌ (assumed tropical:) Such a one drove me away, and subjected me to trouble, or difficulty. (TA.) See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
